reviews.text: Fairly thick toner pad with plenty of toner in it. Personally won’t buy them again because there’s better options out there. They are gently but smell a bit weird I’d recommend them to a young teenager.
reviews.zh: 呢款toner pad幾厚，入面有好多toner。但個人唔會再回購，因為有更好嘅選擇。Pad算溫和，但聞落有少少怪味，我會推薦畀青少年用。

reviews.text: I love this potato pads, I used them whenever I feel like and it helps calm my skin as it gets irritated quite quickly and helps with acne as well. I used the pads instead of a Madecassoside mask, I think it's a quick comfortable alternative... I really do like them but I wish they would stick slightly better
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款馬鈴薯pad，feel like想用就用，佢可以幫助舒緩我容易受刺激嘅皮膚，對暗瘡都有幫助。我用pad代替Madecassoside mask，覺得係一個快速又舒服嘅代替品……我真係好鍾意，但希望佢貼服度可以再好少少。

reviews.text:
I’ve heard great things about this toner pad being more gentle than the carrot pads and! I’ve been dying to get my hands on them. When I saw that it was in the spring blossom box,
I jumped at the chance to get it!
reviews.zh: 一直聽聞呢款toner pad比蘿蔔pad更加溫和!好想買返嚟試。見到佢喺spring blossom box入面，就即刻把握機會買咗！

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Potato Madecassoside Soothing Pad 60P (+10P) Special set (OY Exclusive)
reviews.text:
The Potato Madecassoside Soothing Pad is a highly effective toner pad for moisturizing dry skin. Made from Gangwon-do potatoes, each pad is infused with numerous herbal extracts, helping the skin recover quickly. The toner has a slightly sticky texture and the scent of centella asiatica. Therefore, those who are allergic or unaccustomed to this smell should reconsider using it.

This toner pad is particularly suitable for dry skin due to its sticky consistency post-application. However, it can also be used for skin with hidden acne. If your skin becomes red or feels a stinging sensation after use, you should stop using the product immediately.

In summary, the Potato Madecassoside Soothing Pad is an excellent choice for those with dry skin needing hydration and recovery. However, be mindful of the scent and your skin’s reaction to ensure it suits your skin type.
reviews.zh:
Potato Madecassoside Soothing Pad係一款高效嘅toner pad，可以為乾性肌保濕。用江原道馬鈴薯製造，每塊pad都注滿多種草本萃取，幫助皮膚快速修復。Toner質地有少少黏笠，有積雪草嘅氣味。所以，對呢種氣味敏感或者唔習慣嘅人應該要重新考慮使用。

呢款toner pad因為用完之後有黏笠感，所以特別適合乾性肌。但有隱藏暗瘡嘅皮膚都可以用。如果用完之後皮膚變紅或者有刺痛感，就應該即刻停用。

總括嚟講，Potato Madecassoside Soothing Pad係需要保濕同修復嘅乾性肌嘅絕佳選擇。不過要留意氣味同自己皮膚嘅反應，確保適合自己嘅膚質。

reviews.text: Great product. The pads are really big and fun to use but I don’t like that the expiration date is so close. 6 months to use is not much. Besides that I really love the product and I definitely recommend

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Potato Madecassoside Soothing Pad 60P (+10P) Special set (OY Exclusive)
reviews.text: Заказала сразу вместе с морковными пудами для чередования. Первое впечатление отличное. Поды хорошо пропитаны тонером и кожа после них насыщена влагой. То что надо на жаркое лето. У нас уже почти 30 градусов жары
reviews.zh: 同蘿蔔pad一齊買返嚟輪住用。第一印象好好。Pad好夠toner，皮膚用完充滿水潤。正正適合炎熱嘅夏天。我哋呢度已經差唔多30度。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Potato Madecassoside Soothing Pad 60P (+10P) Special set (OY Exclusive)
reviews.text:
The packaging is really fun to look at, and very pleasant to touch in hands. The pads look like potato slices, and they smell a bit like potato, too. A product created with such care, makes me want to take my skincare routine more seriously, too. The downside is that the pads are not very moisturizing, but they do feel nice on my skin. Overall, great product!

There is also a gift of two carrot pads included. Since I hate eating carrots, I worry that I might not like it on my skin, either. I tried the carrot pads on my husband’s face. His face got very red afterwards. He does like carrots 😅 So it’s hard to know. Just try them and see if they are good for you.
reviews.zh:
包裝望落好得意，拎上手嘅觸感都好舒服。啲pad睇落好似薯仔片，聞落都有少少薯仔味。用心製作嘅產品令我都想更認真對待自己嘅護膚程序。缺點係啲pad保濕效果一般，但喺皮膚上用嘅感覺唔錯。整體係好產品！

另外仲送咗兩片紅蘿蔔pad。因為我好憎食紅蘿蔔，所以都擔心搽喺皮膚上會唔會唔鍾意。我將紅蘿蔔pad試咗喺老公塊面度，用完之後佢塊面變得好紅。但佢係鍾意食紅蘿蔔嘅😅所以都好難講，自己試下啱唔啱你。

reviews.shade: SKINFOOD Potato Madecassoside Soothing Pad 60P (+10P) Special set (OY Exclusive)
reviews.text:
LOVE THIS!! Skinfood toner pads really do hits different 😍 🥔❤️ 🤩🥔

These cotton pads are super soft, multi-layered and soaked in soothing goodness 🍃🥔💦💆🏻‍♀️. I have rosacea and some hormonal breakouts which was quickly calmed by these pads. They also gave my skin a glowy and clear complexion, great for makeup prep.

The adherences of these pads are good but the way I use it may affect this. They’re stretchy and easy to divide into thinner layers to cover the entire face. Despite that, the texture remains sturdy and does not break down easily regardless of the tug and pulls. 💪🏼🤩🏋🏻‍♀️

Overall, I highly recommend this product and would repurchase! 🥰❤️
reviews.zh:
超鍾意呢個!!Skinfood爽膚水pad真係唔同啲😍 🥔❤️ 🤩🥔

呢啲化妝棉超軟，係多層設計，浸透晒舒緩成分🍃🥔💦💆🏻‍♀️。我有玫瑰痤瘡同埋偶爾嘅荷爾蒙爆瘡，用咗之後好快就鎮靜咗。用完皮膚變得水光透亮，妝前用好適合。

pad嘅貼膚度唔錯，但可能同我嘅用法有關。佢哋有彈性，可以輕鬆撕開做薄啲嘅層去敷成塊面。雖然撕開咗，但質地依然紮實，點拉扯都唔容易散。💪🏼🤩🏋🏻‍♀️

整體嚟講，我高度推薦呢個產品，一定會回購！🥰❤️
